Procedure
The student:
Step 1 Adds a sample of solid Q to 10.0 cm of distilled water in a test-tube.
Step 2 Places the test-tube into a hot water-bath and stirs the mixture until all of Q dissolves.
Step 3 Places the test-tube with the hot solution into a beaker of cold water to cool the
solution.
Step 4 Records the temperature when the first crystals of Q appear in the test-tube.
The temperature when the first crystals appear is 45.0 °C.

parts.text:

solution in air instead of in cold water.

the first crystals appear.
